hooks.command: uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); print(p)" | { read -r f; f="${f%$''}"; case "$f" in *.py) uv run black "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); print(p)" | { read -r f; f="${f%$''}"; case "$f" in *.py) uv run ruff check "$f" ;; esac; }; exit 0

uv run python -c "import json,sys,datetime; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); print(f'{datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()} {cmd}')" >> .claude/bash-history.log 2>/dev/null || true
